props.text: User Manager demo — EDITS ARE REAL against the gateway's 'default' user source: data.users binds system.user.getUsers() (the binding seeds the same three demo users as /roster), roles and schedules bind their catalogs. Filter the rail, edit names/roles/schedule/contact info, stage a password (allowPasswordChange is ON here — the staged value travels only in the onUserSave payload), then Save; '+ New user' creates one; Delete asks twice (the demo script refuses to delete 'admin' so the gateway stays usable). 'Manage roles' (allowRoleManagement is ON here) edits the role CATALOG — add/rename/delete roles for real; the demo refuses to delete 'Administrator'.
